title: Baba Nest Rooftop (Phuket)
description: Experience sunset cocktails on a floating rooftop deck surrounded by a 360-degree infinity pool at Baba Nest Sri Panwa after playing Phuket's best golf.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Baba Nest, located at Sri Panwa in Phuket, is a luxury rooftop bar offering a 360-degree infinity pool experience and panoramic views of the Andaman Sea and surrounding limestone islands. Securing a table requires weeks of advance notice, with optimal arrival at 5:00 PM for sunset viewing.
> 
> * The experience is designed for a 2-hour duration during sunset (5:00 PM–7:00 PM), enforcing a strict advance reservation policy and minimum spend per guest.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Lounge on a floating wooden deck completely surrounded by a 360-degree infinity pool at Sri Panwa. It is widely considered one of the best rooftop bars in the world.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Sri Panwa fundamentally shifted the luxury landscape in Phuket. Baba Nest was designed to offer an utterly seamless horizon—a cocktail bar where the water, the islands, and the sky merge without interruption.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Securing a table requires weeks of advance notice. Arrive precisely at 5:00 PM to secure your low-slung lounge cushion before the sunset begins. 

You order premium Mexican tapas and signature high-end cocktails (utilizing ingredients like lemongrass and ginger). As the sun sets over the Andaman Sea and the surrounding limestone islands, the view is nothing short of cinematic magic.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Exclusive, Cinematic, Ultra-Luxurious |
| **Duration** | 2 Hours (Sunset) |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | An ultimate sunset transition on a Phuket golf trip. |

## Sequencing a 5:00 PM Sri Panwa Sunset With Phuket’s Championship Golf Courses
Perched at the southern tip of Cape Panwa overlooking the Andaman Sea and Lone, Coral, and Racha islands, **Baba Nest at Sri Panwa** sits roughly 35 minutes south of [Red Mountain Golf Club](/courses/thailand/red-mountain/) and [Loch Palm](/courses/thailand/) in Kathu, and 50 to 60 minutes south of [Blue Canyon Country Club](/courses/thailand/blue-canyon/), [Laguna Golf Phuket](/courses/thailand/laguna-phuket/), [Mission Hills Phuket Golf Resort](/courses/thailand/mission-hills-phuket/), and coastal resorts like [Amanpuri](/accommodations/thailand/amanpuri/) and [Banyan Tree Phuket](/accommodations/thailand/banyan-tree-phuket/).

Because Baba Nest’s floating teak deck holds fewer than 20 sunken wrap-around infinity-pool cushions—and strictly releases seats only for the 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM sunset window—Asia Golf Specialists locks in your table up to 60 days ahead alongside your [Phuket Island Links](/tours/phuket-island-links/) tee sheet.

## Optimal Phuket Golf-Day Pacing & Sri Panwa Dining Progression
* **Pair With a Morning Round at Red Mountain Golf Club:** Tee off at 07:30 AM on Jon Morrow’s dramatic tin-mine cliffs at [Red Mountain Golf Club](/courses/thailand/red-mountain/) (the closest championship course to Cape Panwa), finish by noon for a pool swim and shower at your resort, and depart at 4:00 PM in your private luxury MPV to step onto Baba Nest’s floating deck at 5:00 PM sharp.
* **Stay on Cape Panwa for Dinner at *Baba Iki* or *Baba Soul Food*:** Rather than driving back north immediately at 7:00 PM, we reserve a private ocean-view table one level below at Sri Panwa’s *Baba Soul Food* (authentic Southern Phuket crab curry and crispy pork belly) or *Baba Iki* (Japanese teppanyaki and sashimi) so your group enjoys a complete evening on the cape.

## Door-to-Door Chauffeur Coordination From Phuket’s West Coast Resorts
Because Cape Panwa sits at the southeastern peninsula of Phuket—roughly 45 to 55 minutes from northwest beach sanctuaries like [Amanpuri](/accommodations/thailand/amanpuri/) and [Banyan Tree Phuket](/accommodations/thailand/banyan-tree-phuket/) near [Laguna Golf Phuket](/courses/thailand/laguna-phuket/) and [Blue Canyon Country Club](/courses/thailand/blue-canyon/)—having a dedicated private luxury MPV and driver on standby at Sri Panwa eliminates the notorious difficulty of finding late-evening return taxis from the cape.

faqs.q: How far in advance do sunset tables at Baba Nest Phuket book out?
faqs.a: Because Baba Nest's floating infinity-pool deck seats a strictly limited number of guests each sunset (5:00 PM–7:00 PM), non-hotel guests must reserve 3 to 6 weeks in advance during Phuket's November–April peak golf season.

faqs.q: Which Phuket golf course is closest to Baba Nest at Sri Panwa?
faqs.a: Red Mountain Golf Club in central Kathu sits roughly 35 minutes northwest of Cape Panwa, making a morning round at Red Mountain the ideal pairing before an afternoon shower and 5:00 PM sunset drinks at Baba Nest.

faqs.q: What is the minimum spend and dress code at Baba Nest Phuket?
faqs.a: Baba Nest requires a per-person food and beverage minimum spend (typically 2,000–3,000 THB per guest) and enforces a smart resort-casual dress code—no swimwear, sleeveless singlets, or hotel slippers.
